# Jamnet

> > Jamnet is a comprehensive scholarship, grant, internship, and education hub connecting global opportunities with aspiring professionals and students.

Jamnet aggregates fully-funded fellowships, scholarships, and career development programs from top institutions and organizations worldwide, including USA, UK, EU, Canada, and Nigeria-based opportunities. The platform serves international students, postgraduate scholars, and early-career professionals seeking educational funding and professional development.

## Key Topics

- Fully-funded scholarships
- Fellowship programs
- 2026 opportunities
- Chevening Fellowship
- USA funding
- UK scholarships
- International students
- Postgraduate education
- Career development
- Graduate training
- European Union programs
- Healthcare education
- Artificial Intelligence
- Entrepreneurship funding
- Policy fellowships
